# Studio NACRT US

> Studio NACRT US is a luxury interior design and photoreal 3D visualization studio based in Miami, Florida, serving high-end residential, condo and penthouse, multifamily, hospitality, and commercial clients across the United States. It is the United States branch of Studio NACRT, founded in Belgrade, Serbia in 2014.

## About
- Name: Studio NACRT US
- Location: 740 W 26th St, Hialeah, FL 33010 (Miami metro)
- Serves: Miami, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Brickell, Fort Lauderdale, Palm Beach, and clients across the United States
- Contact: info@studionacrt.us
- Parent studio: Studio NACRT (Belgrade, Serbia, est. 2014) - https://studionacrt.com

## Services
- Luxury Residential Interior Design: bespoke homes, penthouses, and villas from concept to final install
- Multifamily & Commercial Interior Design: cohesive design systems for developments, lobbies, model units, and brand environments
- Hospitality & Condo-Hotel Design: hotels, restaurants, and condo-hotel interiors engineered for guest experience
- Photoreal 3D Visualization: realistic renderings that let clients approve light, material, and detail before build

## Design Approach
Material-led minimalism using stone, concrete, wood, and glass. Lighting-driven mood. European design discipline applied to the Miami luxury market. Full service from first sketch to final install.
